title: TraWell Co S.p.A. (d/b/a Safe Bag)
description:
[retail] TraWell Co S.p.A. (d/b/a Safe Bag), headquartered at Via Olona 183/G, 21013 Gallarate (VA), Italy, is a publicly listed airport services company (Euronext Growth Milan, ticker TWL.MI, ISIN IT0005717571) founded in 1997 by Rudolph Gentile. The company operates 100+ baggage-wrapping shops across 50+ airports in 13 countries including Italy, France, Portugal, Switzerland, Poland, Estonia, Lithuania, the United States (Miami), Canada (Montreal, Ottawa, Vancouver), Brazil, Thailand, serving approximately 12 million customers annually through its Safe Bag, SosTravel, and Care4Bag brands. FY 2024 revenue was EUR 29.9M with net income of EUR 0.21M; market capitalization stands at approximately EUR 11.6M. The company employs 200–400 staff across 13 subsidiaries.

The exfiltrated dataset comprises 492 GB across 110,400 files from five production servers (safesql01, safemdb01, safebag01, safeser01, safedpl01), capturing the company's entire digital infrastructure in three top-level directory trees: Backups (360 GB of SQL Server and MongoDB database backups plus Windows system images), Data (120 GB of application source code, employee home directories, IT system configurations, and corporate documents), and Datastore (12 GB of production application data including POS income files, customer tickets, and web server configurations).

The SQL Server backups contain three production databases: sb_datamanager (55–62 GB per backup, the core business database holding customer transactions, POS data, personnel records, and pricing across all 50+ airports), sb_datacachesql (6.5 GB POS transaction cache with payment card processing data for Visa, Mastercard, and Amex), and sb_usermanager (7.9 MB authentication database with all operator accounts, password hashes, LDAP mappings, and permission structures). The MongoDB backups contain four databases (ab_logger, sb_logger, sb_logmanager, sb_syncmanager) totaling 2.2 GB compressed, capturing full API request/response logs with customer PII from web and mobile interactions. A Windows Image Backup of application server SAFEBAG01 adds a 13 GB VHDX disk image with local credentials and registry hives.

<redacted>

Eleven named employee home directories totaling 95 GB contain deeply personal material: laura.crivelli (41 GB — CFO/Finance: tax returns with fiscal code CRVLRA71R63D198R, bank account statements 2023–2025, medical records, driver's license, INPS social security forms, and family members' documents including minors' vaccination bookings and medical records for Marika and Daniele Labanca); alessandro.notari (7 GB — CEO: board/CDA meeting documents, airport development strategies, tender bid documents, HR/legal correspondence, internal dealing communications for TWL.MI shares); chiara.marinoni (19 GB — HR Manager: employee personnel records, a 354 MB Outlook PST email archive, Swiss employee data, Aruba digital signature materials); marco.carabelli (5.6 GB — Lead Developer: complete SBWrapper POS source code in C# .NET across three version trees plus SBServiceCenterManager and SBScaleManager projects); and seven additional employees (alice.carullo 8.6 GB, luana.mussuto 12 GB, daniele.santin 2 GB, gianluca.farioli 845 MB, alessandra.giavari 7.2 MB, michele.carrara 20 KB, paolo.toscano 8 KB).

The Datastore contains 4,488 POS income reconciliation files (XLS format, January 2024 through September 2026) showing daily revenue by airport and card brand with full bank account details (ABI 2008, CAB 1628, Conto 103494545) for entity TRAWELL CO S.P.A.; 898 customer support ticket files with luggage photographs and flight details; 1.3 GB of Italian electronic invoicing (fatturazione elettronica) XML documents; and firewall configuration backups for D-Link DSR routers at Rome and Gallarate headquarters sites containing VPN tunnel configurations, access control lists, and admin credentials.
